title: UAP Task Force members confirm the egg was NHI

tellings.quote: it was also confirmed to me by ranking members of the UAP task force that that is exactly what we ran into that night, that that was NHI.

plain: The egg-shaped object that Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot, says he carried with his helicopter one night in 2014 was, he says, confirmed to him by "ranking members" of the UAP Task Force to be NHI, meaning non-human intelligence. The UAP Task Force was a Pentagon group that studied UAP, short for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs. Barber tells Michels this as what those officials told him, which would mean the government knew he had handled something not made by people.
